findings.text: The company has a status of 'active' with the detail 'active-proposal-to-strike-off'.

No charges are registered against the company, and Companies House holds no insolvency record for it.
PERSON 257 has no other appointments on record, and no registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
